 Special Event and Library Feature Added to Pokémon UNITE
 Oct 27, 2026 
 Thank you for continuing to enjoy Pokémon UNITE.
 We regret to inform you that service for Pokémon UNITE will end on Tuesday, March 23, 2027, at 00:00 UTC.
 For details regarding the end of service, please see here .
 To express our thanks to all Trainers, we’ll be holding a special event until service ends.
 We hope you continue to enjoy Pokémon UNITE until the final day of service.
 Update Date/Time:
 Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 04:00 UTC
 Update Details:
 Unite Coin Exchange will be added
 Unite Coin Missions will begin
 Unite Coin Log-In Bonus will begin
 Library feature will be added
 Unite Coin Exchange
 The Unite Coin Exchange will be added, via which you can exchange special Unite coins for items that have appeared before.
 These items will include Unite licenses, Holowear, Trainer fashion items, Unite snapshot items, and more.
 Open media in a dialog window You can obtain Unite coins via the log-in bonus and special missions that will begin at the same time.
 You can complete missions by winning in a ranked match and in each other battle mode, and each time, you will receive one or more Unite coins.
 Open media in a dialog window We hope you enjoy dressing up your Trainer and favorite Pokémon while taking part in Unite Battles.
 Library Feature
 We plan to implement a “library” feature. This will allow Trainers to visit the Practice Area as well as view items and achievements they obtained in-game—such as Holowear, Unite licenses, Trainer fashion items, emblems, tournament results, and more—even after service ends.
 We are also working on a way to look back at special memories you created with your Pokémon.
 Open media in a dialog window The library feature will be available starting Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 04:00 UTC. After the feature is live, the asset data needed for it will be downloaded when you play the game normally—or when you first access the feature.
 Important Notice Regarding the Data Download
 If you reach the end of service on Tuesday, March 23, 2027, at 00:00 UTC before completing the first data download as described above, you will not be able to use the library feature. Please make sure you complete the data download before the end of service. Also, any new in-game items or records obtained after the first data download will be automatically added to the library feature.
 The library feature will allow players to look back at memories of Pokémon UNITE even after service ends. However, please keep in mind that after service ends, we will not be able to provide support regarding this feature.
 Library data generally cannot be transferred when changing devices. If the game or library data is deleted or otherwise lost after service ends, it may not be recoverable. Support for the library feature will not be available after service ends.
 The library feature is planned to include the following.
 Main Menu
 Open media in a dialog window You will be able to access a variety of the library feature’s content via the main menu.
 Just like with the current main menu, you will be able to freely select Trainer fashion, Pokémon, Holowear, and backgrounds from those you own.
 Also, you will be able to hide certain UI elements for taking commemorative photos of your Trainer and Pokémon.
 Viewing Unite Licenses and Holowear

 You’ll also be able to view the Pokémon you own Unite licences for, as well as change their Holowear and license art.
 As usual, the Pokémon marked as favorite will appear on the main menu in its selected Holowear.
 Practice Area
 Open media in a dialog window Here, you’ll be able to view Holowear effects and Pokémon moves.
 Closet
 Open media in a dialog window Here, you’ll be able to switch between Trainer fashion items you own.
 As usual, fashion items you select will be reflected on the main menu.
 Unite Snapshot
 Open media in a dialog window Here, you’ll be able to freely select your Unite snapshot’s frame, stickers, fashion items, background, expression, and pose from those you own.
 Battle Items, Held Items, Boost Emblems
 Open media in a dialog window 
 Open media in a dialog window 
 Active carousel item 1 of 2.

 Page 2 
 Battle items, held items, and boost emblems you own will be available for viewing only.
 We recommend you finish merging your boost emblems and upgrading your held items by Tuesday, March 23, 2027, at 00:00 UTC.
 Trainer Achievements, Pokémon Achievements, Tournament Participation
 Open media in a dialog window Records of your Trainer achievements, your Pokémon achievements, and tournaments you participated in up to Tuesday, March 23, 2027, at 00:00 UTC will be available to view.
 Again, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone involved with Pokémon UNITE up to this point.
 We hope you continue to enjoy Pokémon UNITE until service ends.
